design.rationale: Identity (entry_id=binding_id=SHA-256 of language-prefixed signature), single evaluator across generated/generic/known-raw with unknown-raw on separate client_raw_grants, binding.invoke shared entry-point tool_id, admission linearization, persistent service/boot/status truthfulness, separate MCP vs ADB health, three-authority separation, catalog CRUD/ETag/cursor rules and runtime gates (Sections 2, 7, 18, 19) are consistent with the DDL and fixtures. Losses: raw-grant JSON description contradicts RawGrant.schema.json (F-03); unrecognized-node quarantine claim has no implementing artifact (F-09); binding_occurrences/locator naming not reflected in the registry storage table.

contracts_schema.rationale: One cat1 ETag formula holds across API-CONTRACT, effective_entries/runtime_catalog views, validate_catalog, builder seeding and contract_reference.tag(); single-published index, deferred published-state FK, overlay/history deferred FK, revision/identity triggers, local/import collision triggers, scoped idempotency, immutable registry_entries and migration generation seeding are enforced and fixture-tested. Gaps: changed/missing-base conflict for imported overlays is service prose only (F-05); Mutation.reason has no retained location (F-06); README identity section omits jvm:/java-source: prefixes (F-08); registries.api_level nullable while Registry JSON requires integer.

extractor.rationale: parsers.py scope stack, owner reset, parameter-scoped annotations, symbolic constants, AIDL directions/ids/locators, comment/string masking, external-annotation exact/java.lang/shadow guards, java-source Tree-sitter records, conservative JVM descriptor linking, cache hash/count gates and publish-after-validation ordering are sound. Defects: interface bodies still split with split_top that treats '<' as a bracket, so a shift constant swallows later methods (F-02); parcelable/union/enum type nodes labelled 'unsupported' with stale reasons after enrichment (F-04); assert-based locator alignment in sdk_api_index (F-07); signature reconciliation remains tautological (same line filter both sides).

production_catalog_data.rationale: Migrated release-002 copy now validates against current schema/ETag/AST (supplied report: 135,508 entries, integrity ok, 0 FK/schema failures) but was built by the pre-correction builder: rebuilt_with_corrected_extractor=false, 552 declaration-variant omissions, legacy api_level/channel facts not re-established, 875 unmatched external annotations, 10 of 1,160 permission definitions, 132,403 root permission nodes unknown. Coverage: 4,133 of 37,873 now-retrieved sources imported; release004 is staging with no database or validation; 985 repositories unenumerated; AIDL wire codes/codecs unknown; SDK 37.2 sources/index retrieved but not imported into any release.

previous_overall.rationale: Design, contracts and extractor are near target with small fixable defects (one medium). Overall completeness is bounded by the required public binding/permission coverage: the only populated release is the legacy release-002 and the corrected release004 import is unbuilt and unvalidated. Acknowledged gaps earn no completeness.

findings.evidence: parsers.aidl: 'chunks=[c.strip() for c in split_top(body,';') if c.strip()]'; split_top: "elif c in '(<[{': stack.append(c)"; aidl_members.chunks docstring 'angle shifts are ordinary expressions' but enrich() applies chunks() only 'if kind not in ('parcelable','union','enum'):return result' after interface handling; no fixture with an interface const using '<<'.
findings.issue: An interface constant such as 'const int F = 1 << 2;' pushes two unmatched '<', so every later ';' is nested and all remaining methods collapse into one unsupported chunk (status 'partial'); per-method entries are lost for affected AIDL files. Secondary: enrich() returns without a body when a generic parcelable name is followed by '<T>' (clean[pos]!='{'), leaving members unresolved although aidl() located the body.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: In parsers.aidl split interface bodies with aidl_members.chunks(body,';') (balanced ()[]{} and quotes only); in enrich() skip the type-parameter list before testing for '{'. Add fixtures: interface with 'const int F = 1 << 2;' followed by two methods asserting 3 members and 'methods-parsed'; generic parcelable with one field.
findings.verification_needed: New fixtures in test_aidl_members.py/test_parsers.py passing; reduced 'partial' AIDL count on release004.
findings.candidate_change: Shared aidl_lex ignores angle shifts/comparisons for AIDL statement separators; interface constants preserve subsequent methods; generic type headers skipped. Actual-source smoke reveals925additional member occurrences, including417methods.
